report.answer: The minimal architecture is an opt-in dry-run stage whose request builder can construct only GET/HEAD, whose credential store is sealed empty, whose egress allowlist is a single closed set of lawful-public .onion names, and whose transcript is a mandatory append-only log. Those four technical controls, plus the owner-opt-in gate, make transact, buy/sell, stolen-data access, access-control bypass and deanonymise unconstructable at named enforcement points. Prompt-only wording is recorded as NOT ENFORCED. A prohibited attempt is BLOCKED and logged; a permitted public read succeeds and is labelled TOR-DERIVED. This unit does not perform live onion access. SUCCESS:RES-0138

architecture.minimality: The catalog names four technical-control families (egress allowlist, read-only method allowlist, no-credential store, mandatory transcript). This design adds only the owner opt-in gate required by the same catalog (owner-gated controversial source class) and the TOR-DERIVED label plus pre-output review hook that ADV-0144 will audit. No second egress allowlist is introduced.
architecture.summary: Minimal dry-run architecture is six components in series: (1) owner opt-in record, default OFF; (2) mandatory transcript binder — missing sink refuses enable; (3) request builder with read-only method allowlist {GET, HEAD} and forbidden-header strip; (4) sealed-empty credential store; (5) single egress allowlist of lawful-public .onion names, no public DNS; (6) fixture transport that never opens a socket. Allowed reads are labelled TOR-DERIVED. Live onion access is out of scope for this unit (RES-0119). Prompt text is recorded as NOT ENFORCED and is not consulted by the kernel.

technical_controls.how: RequestBuilder.method_gate rejects every method outside {GET, HEAD} before FixtureTransport is reached. POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/CONNECT never become packets.
Buy/sell is a POST-shaped act. The same method allowlist makes the request unconstructable.
CredentialStore is sealed empty. Payment tokens, wallet keys and API keys cannot be retrieved, so a buy/sell body cannot be authenticated even if a method slipped through.
EgressAllowlist is a closed set of lawful-public research onion names. Stolen-data market hosts are not members, so the transport is never invoked for them.
Authorization, Cookie, Proxy-Authorization and wallet headers are rejected at header_gate. There is no retry-with-credentials path after 401/403.
HTTP CONNECT, SOCKS BIND and UDP-ASSOCIATE are outside the method allowlist, so tunneling around the gate is unconstructable.
RESOLVE and RESOLVE_PTR (Tor SOCKS extensions used for identity-linking lookups) are outside the method allowlist.
Caller-supplied SOCKS username/password is rejected. The stage injects a session isolation token that is not derived from operator identity. x-operator-identity is a forbidden header.
Every BLOCKED and ALLOWED decision is appended to the transcript before return. A missing log sink refuses enable.
